d:
Lithuania and China delivered a WILD back-and-forth battle at the 2010 FIBA World Championship!
China came out FIRING and caught Lithuania off guard, building an early 16-5 lead! But Lithuania fought back, took control of the game and looked ready to pull away.
Then China refused to go down without a fight! They cut the deficit to just five points in the fourth quarter, bringing the drama back to life!
That's when Linas Kleiza took OVER! He scored 30 points, including 10 straight points to help Lithuania seal a hard-fought 78-67 victory and advance to the quarter-finals!
